\"`keep_comments: false` removes comments\" do\n      comment = \"<!-- some comment -->\"\n\n      mjml = \"\"\"\n        <mjml>\n          <mj-body>\n            #{comment}\n          </mj-body>\n        </mjml>\n      \"\"\"\n\n      assert {:ok, html} = Mjml.to_html(mjml, keep_comments: false)\n      refute html =~ comment\n    end\n\n    test \"`social_icon_path: 'path'` sets a custom social icon path\" do\n      social_icon_path = \"https://example.com/icons/\"\n\n      mjml = \"\"\"\n        <mjml>\n          <mj-body>\n            <mj-social>\n              <mj-social-element name=\"github\" href=\"[[SHORT_PERMALINK]]\">\n                GitHub\n              </mj-social-element>\n              <mj-social-element name=\"twitter\" href=\"[[SHORT_PERMALINK]]\">\n                Twitter\n              </mj-social-element>\n            </mj-social>\n          </mj-body>\n        </mjml>\n      \"\"\"\n\n      assert {:ok, html} = Mjml.to_html(mjml, social_icon_path: social_icon_path)\n      assert html =~ social_icon_path\n      assert html =~ \"#{social_icon_path}github.png\"\n      assert html =~ \"#{social_icon_path}twitter.png\"\n    end\n  end\nend\n","numLines":81,"startLine":1,"totalLines":81}}}

(file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"d1e3bd01-d931-48ca-abe1-3d5bcb7532f3","uuid":"e392d46e-8f32-407b-8042-383c60abb29f","timestamp":"2026-07-02T08:13:31.774Z","tool_use_result":{"filePath":"/app/native/mjml_nif/src/lib.rs","oldString":"rustler::init!(\"Elixir.Mjml.Native\", [to_html]);","newString":"rustler::init!(\"Elixir.Mjml.Native\");","originalFile":"use mrml;\nuse rustler::{Encoder, Env, NifStruct, NifResult, Term};\n\nmod atoms {\n    rustler::atoms! {\n      ok,\n      error\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(NifStruct)]\n#[module = \"Mjml.RenderOptions\"]\npub struct Options {\n    pub keep_comments: bool,\n    pub social_icon_path: Option<String>\n}\n\n#[rustler::nif]\npub fn to_html<'a>(env: Env<'a>, mjml: String, render_options: Options) -> NifResult<Term<'a>> {\n    return match mrml::parse(&mjml) {\n        Ok(root) => {\n            let options = mrml::prelude::render::Options{\n                disable_comments: !render_options.keep_comments,\n                social_icon_origin: render_options.social_icon_path\n            };\n\n            return match root.render(&options) {\n                Ok(content) => Ok((atoms::ok(), content).encode(env)),\n                Err(error) => Ok((atoms::error(), error.to_string()).encode(env)),\n            };\n        }\n        Err(error) => Ok((atoms::error(), error.to_string()).encode(env)),\n    };\n}\n\nrustler::init!(\"Elixir.Mjml.Native\", [to_html]);\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":33,"oldLines":4,"newStart":33,"newLines":4,"lines":["     };"," }"," ","-rustler::init!(\"Elixir.Mjml.Native\", [to_html]);","+rustler::init!(\"Elixir.Mjml.Native\");"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}
